standard.description: RF Reference Source (96000 Series; 96270A with microwave output, 96040A leveling head)
standard.confidence_text: [Not Specified] - not printed in the Operators Manual
standard.reference: Fluke 96000 Series Operators Manual, Chapters 1-3 (printed pp.1-1 to 3-120). Accuracy specifications are NOT in this manual (p.1-2 refers to www.fluke.com).
standard.author: built from the manual page images by specs/build_96270a_standard_from_manual.py

notes.1: Manual p.1-2 (PDF p.8): "Complete specifications for the Product are at www.fluke.com." The Operators Manual prints no accuracy, flatness, stability, harmonic, spurious or 90 d / 1 yr / 2 yr specification. No confidence level / coverage factor is printed anywhere.
notes.2: Operating limits, NOT accuracy (Table 3-22, p.3-67, PDF p.93; Table 3-29, p.3-89, PDF p.115). Leveling Head output: frequency 0.001 Hz to 4.024 GHz, level -130.000 to +24 dBm (50 ohm) with 20 dBm max above 125.75 MHz and 14 dBm max above 1.4084 GHz; -136.000 to +18 dBm (75 ohm) with 14 dBm max above 125.75 MHz and 8 dBm max above 1.4084 GHz. Level units printed: dBm, Vp-p and Vrms (uV, mV, V), W (nW, uW, mW, W), dBuV. Level step 0.001 dB to 130 dB.
notes.3: Operating limits, NOT accuracy (Table 3-29, p.3-89, PDF p.115): 96270A Microwave O/P Direct: frequency 0.001 Hz to 27 GHz; level -4 dBm to +24 dBm, 20 dBm max above 1.4048 GHz, [-100 dBm minimum, above 20 GHz +18 dBm max] (the bracket is printed for the Extended Low Level Microwave Output option).
notes.4: Reference Frequency Output connector (Table 3-2, p.3-25, PDF p.51): BNC, 1 MHz or 10 MHz user selectable, 1.5 V pk-pk nominal into 50 ohm (-0.4 V to 1.1 V), 3.0 V pk-pk nominal into 1 kohm (-0.4 V to 2.6 V, TTL or 3 V compatible). No frequency accuracy or aging is printed.
notes.5: Reference Frequency Input connector (Table 3-3, p.3-25, PDF p.51): BNC, 1 MHz to 20 MHz in 1 MHz steps (phase-noise specification holds only for 10 MHz or 20 MHz), "Lock Range +/-0.3 ppm" (on-screen lock indicator), 1 V pk nominal (+/-5 V pk max), 50 ohm, lock bandwidth 0.5 Hz nominal. The lock range is the capture window of the external-reference input, not an output-frequency accuracy; it is not stored as a specification.

problems.what: NO SPECIFICATION ROWS: the Operators Manual has no specifications chapter. Printed p.1-2 (PDF p.8) says complete specifications are at www.fluke.com. Needed and absent: RF level accuracy and flatness by frequency and level (leveling head and microwave output), frequency accuracy / reference oscillator (aging, temperature stability), harmonics, spurious, phase noise, and any 90 d / 1 yr / 2 yr columns. Supply the specification sheet (or the 96000 Series Service Manual) and extend this builder.
Confidence level / coverage factor is not printed in the Operators Manual. specmanager divisor() falls back to k = 2 for an unspecified level; set the divisor in the manager once the sheet states it.

Direction would be "output". Level unit printed on the instrument is dBm (also W, Vrms, Vp-p, dBuV); no accuracy is printed in any unit, so nothing is stored. A level accuracy stored in dB or % would need a dBm-to-V/W conversion that depends on the 50 / 75 ohm load: decide the storage convention when the sheet arrives.
Level / frequency limits (notes 2, 3) and the reference-frequency connector data (notes 4, 5) are kept as notes only; the schema has no field for operating limits.
Lock Range +/-0.3 ppm (p.3-25) is an input capture range, not an output accuracy; the 96270A time base (internal 10 MHz) accuracy is not printed in this manual.
Confidence level is not specified on the sheet; set the coverage divisor in the manager before relying on this standard.
